scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proof with separate finite numerical consistency checks; no independent mathematical audit or historical-priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean positive-sided rectangles only; arclength-uniform independent endpoints; not a general quadrilateral or convex-body stability theorem. The square value by itself was previously known; the all-aspect monotonic profile and both sharp endpoint rates are the claim. Unindexed predecessors remain possible.
title: Sharp boundary-chord mean-distance profile of Euclidean rectangles
